title: BigP3BCI Study K — 9x8 adaptive/checkerboard, 2 sessions (5 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 5 healthy subjects performing a P300-based brain-computer interface (BCI) speller task using a 9x8 character grid with adaptive/checkerboard stimulus paradigms across 2 sessions. The data were acquired at 256 Hz using 16 EEG channels and represent a derivative subset of the BigP3BCI study, the largest public P300 BCI dataset containing recordings from approximately 267 subjects across 20 studies. This dataset is suitable for benchmarking P300 detection algorithms and evaluating BCI speller performance.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage at a sampling rate of 256 Hz. The experimental paradigm employed a P300 speller task with a 9x8 character grid using adaptive/checkerboard stimulus presentation. Each trial had a duration of 1.0 second, with events classified as Target or NonTarget stimuli. Data were collected from 5 healthy subjects across 2 sessions per subject in a laboratory environment with online feedback provided to participants.
